advertiser_names.verdict: not fixed on the live data; the change is correct code and a measured no-op
advertiser_names.measured: GET /api/advertisers/identity reports count 41, resolved 41, rules_rows 45, bound_to_a_rules_row 0. mergeRowWithIdentity in advertiser-stats-helpers.js only sets bound_advertiser when record.rules.advertiser_id is truthy, which is 0 of 41, so identityName() reads '' on every row.
advertiser_names.on_screen: the כללי תמחור tab (which is also where the מפרסמים rail entry lands) shows 45 rows reading ADV_01 through ADV_45. Zero real Hebrew names. The header reads 45 שורות תמחור, 0 מתמחרות מפרסם.
advertiser_names.is_the_unnamed_case_honest: yes. Each card says לא מתמחר אף אחד, revenue and profitability show a dash rather than a zero, and the page paragraph explains that a row with no advertiser name prices nobody. So the surface is honest; it is just still id-only.
advertiser_names.test_gap: tests/test_two_known_broken_surfaces.py feeds the shipped module a synthetic row with bound_advertiser 'פריסבי'. That case does not occur on the shipped data, so 14 green tests coexist with 0 real names on screen. No test asserts the live outcome.

position_model.verdict: well built, honest, and provably inert
position_model.vocabulary_live: the rate card's מיקום בברייק layer now lists ראשון, שני, שלישי, רביעי, חמישי, אחרון (L), אמצע (ברירת מחדל), with enabled=false and live_today=false, and per-key configured flags so ordinals 4 and 5 read as unset rather than as a chosen 1.0
position_model.preferred_positions_card: renders לא הוגדר and the refusal sentence, and names both counting methods bilingually. It is read-only: there is no way to SET a preferred set from any dashboard surface, so the tri-state can only ever be unset from the UI.
position_model.price_slot_resolution_measured: position 3 of a 3-spot break -> key '3' (שלישי); position 5 of 7 -> default_middle; position 7 of 7 -> 'L' (אחרון (L)). final_cpp 69.00 in all three, because the layer is off. wired_off_layers reports the would-be multiplier.
position_model.latent_behaviour_change_to_name: kairos/optimize/_rule_helpers.py::position_scope_tokens now canonicalises advertiser_rules.csv allow_positions. Exactly one row carries a word form: ADV_02 allow_positions 'first,last', which previously could never match an integer position_in_break and therefore matched nothing. It now resolves to {1, L}. ADV_02 is bound to nobody today (bound_to_a_rules_row 0) so this is inert, and the daily ledger is unchanged at 699,450.00, but the day that row is bound its meaning flips from 'allowed nowhere' to 'allowed at 1 and L'.
position_model.note: kairos/model/spec.py DEFAULT_BREAK_POSITIONS was correctly left alone. It is the break-inside-programme axis, not the spot-inside-break axis.

smaller_things_worth_a_line: נתוני זרע הדגמה is a literal rendering of 'demo seed data'. זרע reads oddly in Hebrew for a data seed; נתוני הדגמה alone would read as trade Hebrew.
A demo row's מה לעשות column still reads הקמפיין מוזמן ועומד עד שתסיימו אותו, which tells the operator a demo campaign is booked and standing.

price-slot names the resolved key '3' for the tail spot of a three-spot break, because a priced ordinal wins for pricing. That is documented and is the parity-preserving choice, but an operator auditing whether the tail premium applied will read '3' where the spot is also L.

DemoBadge uses a MUI Tooltip inside a subtree that otherwise uses plain spans and lucide icons. That is the whole cause of the 16 broken tests, and a plain title attribute or the existing tooltip idiom would have cost nothing.
shortest_path: Take @mui/material out of DemoBadge.jsx (a title attribute or whatever the surrounding clients code already uses). That alone returns 16 tests to green.

Rebase tests/golden_weekly_schedule.py and output/weekly_break_schedule.csv onto the engine as it stands, or revert the settings change in 8f0c78c9. Three different totals for one week is the single least defensible number in the repository.
Mark the rebate on the client tree, or stop showing נטו there until agencies.csv is real. Marking the agency card and not the money derived from it is half a fix.

Either bind the 45 rules rows to the 41 observed advertisers in the store, or say plainly on that surface that no pricing row is bound to any advertiser yet. The display join cannot invent a key that does not exist.
Scope kairos_api/campaigns_read.py::_build_campaigns to the operator channel, or drop the rollup panel from the Campaigns destination.
